components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The focused burgundy action for order and primary conversion moments.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:14px 36px; border:0; border-radius:50px; background:var(--lycious_burgundy); color:var(--lycious_ivory); font:600 .9375rem/1.5 var(--font-body); cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(122,33,46,.35); transition:all .3s var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--lycious_burgundy-hover); transform:translateY(-3px); box-shadow:0 12px 35px rgba(122,33,46,.45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet outlined action that supports the primary burgundy button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:12px 34px; border:2px solid var(--pink-400); border-radius:50px; background:transparent; color:var(--pink-700); font:600 .9375rem/1.5 var(--font-body); cursor:pointer; transition:all .3s var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--pink-100); border-color:var(--pink-600); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A warm, softly rounded field for order and contact details.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:grid; gap:6px; color:var(--pink-800); font:600 .875rem/1.5 var(--font-body); } .ds-field { min-height:48px; padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid var(--cream-dark); border-radius:14px; background:#fff; color:var(--pink-900); font:400 .9375rem/1.5 var(--font-body); outline:none; transition:border-color .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease; } .ds-field:hover { border-color:var(--pink-300); } .ds-field:focus { border-color:var(--lycious_burgundy); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(111,27,35,.1); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Value Card
components.description: A calm warm-white card that lifts gently to reveal interactivity.
components.html:
✦

Premium Quality

Every element is crafted with care and attention to detail.
components.css: .ds-value-card { max-width:320px; padding:32px; border:1px solid var(--cream-dark); border-radius:16px; background:var(--warm-white); color:var(--pink-800); font:400 .9375rem/1.75 var(--font-body); transition:all .4s var(--ease-out); } .ds-value-card h3 { margin:16px 0 8px; color:var(--lycious_burgundy); font:600 1.375rem/1.15 var(--font-heading); } .ds-value-card p { margin:0; } .ds-value-icon { display:grid; place-items:center; width:72px; height:72px; border-radius:16px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--cream),var(--cream-dark)); color:var(--lycious_burgundy); transition:transform .3s var(--ease-expo); } .ds-value-card:hover { transform:translateY(-8px); border-color:var(--blush); box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg); } .ds-value-card:hover .ds-value-icon { transform:scale(1.1) rotate(5deg); } .ds-value-card:focus-within { outline:3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Compact burgundy navigation with a restrained growing underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position:relative; display:inline-block; padding:4px 0; color:var(--lycious_burgundy); font:500 .875rem/1.5 var(--font-body); letter-spacing:.5px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-link::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:0; width:100%; height:2px; border-radius:2px; background:var(--lycious_burgundy); transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:left; transition:transform .3s var(--ease-expo); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color:var(--lycious_burgundy-hover); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after { transform:scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.description: A translucent ivory pill that keeps bilingual access visible but secondary.
components.css: .ds-lang-toggle { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; min-height:44px; padding:8px 14px; border:1px solid var(--blush); border-radius:50px; background:rgba(253,247,242,.7); color:var(--lycious_burgundy); font:600 .8125rem/1.5 var(--font-body); letter-spacing:1px; cursor:pointer; backdrop-filter:blur(8px); transition:all .3s var(--ease-out); } .ds-lang-toggle svg { width:16px; height:16px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; transition:transform .3s var(--ease-expo); } .ds-lang-toggle:hover { background:rgba(253,247,242,.95); transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); } .ds-lang-toggle:hover svg { transform:scale(1.15); } .ds-lang-toggle:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-lang-toggle:active { transform:translateY(0); }

narrative.overview: Lycious feels like a small contemporary atelier devoted to one exceptional fruit: warm, refined, tactile, and quietly joyful. Editorial typography gives the brand romance and ceremony, while a clear modern sans serif keeps product facts, navigation, and forms effortless to use. The system favors generous breathing room, fruit-led photography, warm pale surfaces, and burgundy as a concentrated signature. It avoids sterile technology styling, neon color, and generic black-and-gold luxury; premium character comes from care, material warmth, and restraint.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial romance balanced by modern clarity
Lycious Ivory surfaces with a concentrated burgundy signature
Soft ambient layering and tactile, confidently rounded controls
Generous responsive rhythm with focused, factual product storytelling

rules.name: The Concentrated Burgundy Rule
rules.body: Burgundy carries meaning because it is focused on brand signatures, actions, and key moments rather than flooding every surface.

rules.name: The Lycious Ivory Rule
rules.body: Refer to the main warm pale surface as Lycious Ivory; do not rename it Fresh Cream.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Playfair expresses; Poppins explains. Do not use the display face for dense facts, form controls, or long utility copy.

rules.name: The Breathing-Room Rule
rules.body: Preserve generous section rhythm while keeping each action visually attached to the content it completes.

rules.name: The Ambient-First Rule
rules.body: Shadows should feel like soft light in a studio; avoid hard black drop shadows and persistent elevation on every card.

dos: Do treat Lycious Ivory as the primary warm pale surface and name it consistently.
Do pair expressive Playfair moments with practical Poppins copy.
Do use burgundy to focus attention on the logo, primary actions, and key editorial emphasis.
Do make responsive layouts feel recomposed, with clear touch targets and readable line lengths.
Do keep depth warm, diffuse, and tied to hierarchy or interaction.
donts: Don't introduce neon colors, cold tech gradients, or generic black-and-gold luxury styling.
Don't fill every card with a shadow or every heading with burgundy.
Don't use Playfair Display for dense product facts, navigation, or form controls.
Don't square off tactile controls or mix many unrelated corner radii.
Don't invent product proof, decorative badges, or visual claims that exceed the evidence on hand.
